about_the_game:
The world ended long ago. Its flesh has curdled to mud, its bones have crumbled to ash, its veins lie petrified and empty.

Its anatomy can barely support its own bloated, rotting corpse. Yet in this most broken of worlds, some things still remain. Unaware of their lot, unaware of their purpose, the Thoughtless lie in sleep. So ever faint was the whisper that reached your slumbering corpse. For you have not truly withered, but cling to the little you have left as it fades. You have awakened, so long have you been gone you have forgotten what you are.

You have seen the world for what it truly is and can never return to your rest. You will surely perish.

Key Features

  • You will surely perish by a days end. Feed off whatever you can find to just have a couple more minutes so you may drag out a pitiful existence in a world that can hardly support itself.

  • Discover the history and secrets of a world that can no longer support itself.

  • Regain your memory of the world and people who created you.

  • Find and group together with your missing brothers and sisters so that you may not perish.

  • Perform forbidden rituals and pacts with the long forgotten, manipulating the world and granting yourself boons so you may endure.

  • Not one playthrough is the same, the world and the things you find in it changing each time.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent violence and general mature content.

short_description: The world is a corpse, unable to even support it's own anatomy. Awaken into a world where life has become foreign, where you are to surely perish. Feed on the scraps to endure for just a few more minutes in hopes that in time, you will breathe life back into a world that has already perished.
